mapper.select: select c.name class_name, count(*) total from clazz c,student s where c.id = s.clazz_id group by c.name;
select (case degree when 1 then '初中' when 2 then '高中' when 3 then '大专' when 4 then '本科' when 5 then '硕士' when 6 then '博士' end) as name ,count(*) value from student group by degree;
